Class RecordingConfig

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.internal.record.RecordingConfig
public final class RecordingConfig extends Object
Configuration for Asciinema (.cast) recording, loaded from system properties. This is an internal API and not part of the public contract.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public static RecordingConfig load()
      Loads recording configuration from system properties and installs capture. This method installs AnsiTerminalCapture immediately so that all System.out output is captured from the start, not just after the first Backend is created.
      Returns:
      configuration if recording is enabled, null otherwise

    • active

      public static RecordingConfig active()
      Returns the active recording config, or null if not recording.
      Returns:
      the active config, or null

    • isEnabled

      public static boolean isEnabled()
      Checks if recording is enabled via system properties. This does NOT install the capture - use load() for that.
      Returns:
      true if recording is configured

    • of

      public static RecordingConfig of(Path outputPath, int fps, int maxDurationMs, int width, int height)
      Creates a config with explicit values (used by TuiRunner for config file support).
      Parameters:
      outputPath - the output file path
      fps - the frames per second
      maxDurationMs - the maximum recording duration in milliseconds
      width - the recording width in columns
      height - the recording height in rows
      Returns:
      a new recording config
